newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal Health to buy Mediqual for stock.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Health to buy Mediqual for stock.

text.p: Cardinal Health Inc said Tuesday it will buy privately-held MediQual Systems Inc in a stock swap valued at $31 million.
Cardinal, a pharmaceutical services company, said MediQual shareholders will receive Cardinal common shares for all of their Mediqual stock. MediQual's shareholders must approve the transaction.
MediQual, a Westborough, Mass.-based supplier of clinical information management systems has annual revenues of about $11 million, Cardinal said in a statement.
